About

About me

I'm a second-year UCD student studying Information & Communication Studies with Economics. Alongside this, I work as an Area Supervisor, supporting operations and eCommerce at One Dame Lane, a €2M+ Irish retail brand.

Over the past year, I've progressed from Sales Assistant into a role with responsibility across two stores, multiple pop-ups, and a team of 15. My work involves supporting day-to-day operations, team coordination, stock management, and online performance.

Alongside this, I've been involved in developing internal processes, managing Shopify, and supporting wider business growth across both retail and eCommerce.

Founder

BizzTrackr

I come from a family of entrepreneurs, so growing up I saw the same challenge again and again. Too much admin, not enough time, and tasks piling up that took focus away from the work they actually enjoyed.

I'm entirely self-taught — I learned how to build AI systems from scratch, and used that to create tools for small business owners around me, which led to the development of BizzTrackr.

It was built to help reduce admin and make day-to-day tasks more manageable — designed for businesses run by one or two people without a large team behind them.
